Review of Kakuu no Koi Monogatari

SubjectKakuu no Koi Monogatari
ByHelpfulness: 1
Vote: 8reader-one on 2026-09-06
ReviewA warm story about two people who keep missing each other.

The common route is slow but the payoff lands. The ending reveals that the letters were never sent. Music is understated and fits every scene, and the art carries the quiet moments well enough that the long stretches of daily life never drag for long.
